note: GreenTrace's Scout registry: what a question about one finished investigation may ask for. Ask answers only an intent listed here; anything else falls to GENERAL, which answers from no line.

intents.description: Anything that is not a question about this investigation.
examples: what can you help me with?
What is the capital of France?

intents.description: Why the verdict is what it is: the deciding finding, its rule and what failed to break it.
examples: Explain the reason for this verdict
Why does the promise not hold?

intents.description: What single change would flip the verdict.
examples: What would make the claim proven?
What change would make it hold?

intents.description: Which refutations the Evaluator tried and what each found.
examples: Did the Evaluator check when P-014 delivered?
What did the Evaluator try to break?

intents.description: Which records support a finding: alerts, plots, deliveries, suppliers.
examples: Where does alert A-221 come from?

intents.description: What the investigation did not test, its limits and what a human must review.
examples: What are the limits of this verdict?

intents.description: A paragraph of a company or NGO report, read as data before a model sees it.
examples: ChocoDurable buys cocoa from twelve farmer cooperatives
100% of our cocoa comes from deforestation-free farms since 2021
Field visit to cooperative F-014 in 2024
